result.instructions: Tools for OKSign, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which documents are still waiting for a signature in my OKsign account?"; "List the documents signed yesterday between 00:00 and 23:59 and who signed them."; "Show how many credits and how much storage my OKsign account has left.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes OKSign data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run oksign_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run oksign_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run oksign_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. oksign_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: oksign_get_credits
tools.title: Get credits and storage
tools.description: The account's remaining credits (quantity), when they expire (validuntil), the plan (subscription), whether it is paid, and storage used (account_size) versus the maximum (max_account_size) in bytes. GET /v1/credits/retrieve.

tools.name: oksign_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: The users of the OKsign account: name, email, mobile, role, status, language and the immutable signerid (use it to tell who signed). GET /v1/users/retrieve.

limit.description: Items to return, 1-500 (default 100). OKsign has no paging; the list is cut here.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: oksign_list_email_templates
tools.title: List email templates
tools.description: The email templates defined in the account: id, name, subject, HTML body, reminder_days and repeat. GET /v1/email-templates/retrieve.

limit.description: Items to return, 1-500 (default 100). OKsign has no paging; the list is cut here.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: oksign_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: The account's contact list: name, email, mobile, actingas (capacity) and group. GET /v1/contacts/retrieve.

limit.description: Items to return, 1-500 (default 100). OKsign has no paging; the list is cut here.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: oksign_list_active_documents
tools.title: List active documents
tools.description: Documents in the account's Active Documents tab: docid, filename, creator, createdate, signatures required/valid, orgtoken, status (1 active, 10 briefcase, 11 document in a briefcase, 12 reusable, 14 template), viaapi and signed_docid when signed. OKsign allows this call only once every 3 minutes (429 otherwise). GET /v1/documents/active.

signed.description: true = only documents that have a signed copy, false = only those without.

orgtoken.description: Only documents uploaded with this organizational token.

filename_contains.description: Only documents whose filename contains this text (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Items to return, 1-500 (default 100). OKsign has no paging; the list is cut here.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: oksign_list_signed_documents
tools.title: List signed documents
tools.description: Documents uploaded through the API that were signed between two moments: signed_docid, source_docid, filename, signerid, signing source, signature counts, completed fields, credits per signer and timestamp. Keep the window short; OKsign allows this call only once every 3 minutes (429 otherwise). GET /v1/documents/signed.

start.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 with a timezone.

end.description: End of the window, ISO 8601 with a timezone.

limit.description: Items to return, 1-500 (default 100). OKsign has no paging; the list is cut here.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: oksign_list_notification_errors
tools.title: List email and SMS delivery errors
tools.description: Email and SMS delivery problems (hard_bounce, soft_bounce, blocked, spam, invalid_email, deferred) for signing invitations sent between two moments: recipient, source_docid, reason, orgtoken and timestamp. Only error events are reported. OKsign allows this call only once every 3 minutes (429 otherwise). GET /v1/webhooks/retrieve.

start.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 with a timezone.

end.description: End of the window, ISO 8601 with a timezone.

limit.description: Items to return, 1-500 (default 100). OKsign has no paging; the list is cut here.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

annotations.title: List email and SMS delivery errors

tools.name: oksign_document_exists
tools.title: Check a document exists
tools.description: Whether a (signed) document still exists on the platform; returns its filename and whether it is a template. GET /v1/document/exists.

docid.description: OKsign document id (docid, source_docid or signed_docid) like 670816-483B7F54-8591-DDF9-FA77-9042AED3E8FD.

tools.name: oksign_get_document_metadata
tools.title: Get signed document metadata
tools.description: Metadata of a signed document (pass the signed_docid): filename, size, signatures required/valid, who signed, and the values of all completed fields (can contain personal data). Metadata v2. GET /v2/metadata/retrieve.

signed_docid.description: OKsign document id (docid, source_docid or signed_docid) like 670816-483B7F54-8591-DDF9-FA77-9042AED3E8FD.

tools.name: oksign_get_form_descriptor
tools.title: Get a document's form descriptor
tools.description: The form descriptor of an uploaded document: its signature and form fields (type, page, position, signer, required, signing options) and the signing URL of each signer. The URLs let their holders sign, so share them only with the signer. GET /v1/formdesc/retrieve.

docid.description: OKsign document id (docid, source_docid or signed_docid) like 670816-483B7F54-8591-DDF9-FA77-9042AED3E8FD.

tools.name: oksign_get_linked_document
tools.title: Find the source or signed copy of a document
tools.description: Given a source_docid, the signed_docid of its signed copy (absent if not signed yet) and the timestamp; given a signed_docid, the source_docid. An empty result means the document never existed here or was removed. GET /v1/linkedlist/retrieve.

docid.description: OKsign document id (docid, source_docid or signed_docid) like 670816-483B7F54-8591-DDF9-FA77-9042AED3E8FD.

annotations.title: Find the source or signed copy of a document

tools.name: oksign_upsert_contacts
tools.title: Add or update contacts
tools.description: WRITE: add contacts to the account's contact list, or update them when a contact with the same email AND name exists (its other fields are replaced). Existing contacts are never cleared. Contacts OKsign rejects are skipped and reported. POST /v1/contacts/upload.

email.description: Email address (with name, the contact's unique key).

name.description: Full name (with email, the contact's unique key).

actingas.description: Capacity or status, e.g. CEO, Shareholder, Client.

mobile.description: Mobile number in E.164 format, e.g. +32495123456.

tools.name: oksign_remove_contacts
tools.title: Remove contacts
tools.description: WRITE: permanently remove contacts from the account's contact list. A contact is identified by its email AND name. Cannot be undone (re-add with oksign_upsert_contacts). POST /v1/contacts/remove.

email.description: Email address of the contact to remove.

name.description: Name of the contact to remove (email AND name identify a contact).

tools.name: oksign_remove_document
tools.title: Remove a document
tools.description: WRITE: permanently remove a (signed) document from the OKsign platform. This deletes the file and its pending webhook events and cannot be undone. A signed document removed right after its callback may answer 'Too soon': retry later. DELETE /v1/document/remove.

docid.description: OKsign document id (docid, source_docid or signed_docid) like 670816-483B7F54-8591-DDF9-FA77-9042AED3E8FD.
